sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Typing no longer jumps to the global filter right after a table loads. Shortly after the final render the script focuses the global filter so you can start filtering at once, and it did so even if you had already clicked into another field, such as a 📊 quick filter, a column filter or MusicBrainz's search box. The rest of your typing then ended up in the global filter. On a slow page this could happen well after the table looked finished. The global filter is now focused only when no other text field has focus.
